title: Resource names
summary: Downloads the resource and game archive name lists from HD2SDK's repository, so conflicts and the asset check name resources instead of giving their numbers.
source: The lists are compiled by the HD2SDK community. This plugin does not include them; the button below downloads the resource names and the game archive names directly from HD2SDK's repository:
none: The name list has not been downloaded.
have: {0} resource names and {2} game archive names, downloaded {1}.
failed: The name list could not be downloaded: {0}
